track_name: Summit Point Raceway - Summit Point Raceway
title: Track Guide Summit Point BMW M2 G87 Rookie Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Break halfway between the four cones and the three cones, 75% pressure
corners.line: Follow the repaved part, turn-in at inside curb
corners.exit: Accelerate following repave, end up middle of track
corners.mistakes: Don't hit the inside curb, avoid gravel

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Break at the end of the road, 35% pressure
corners.line: Get close to inside curb without hitting it
corners.exit: Accelerate, use outside curbing to maximize exit speed

corners.label: T4
corners.exit: End up just about mid track

corners.label: T4
corners.exit: start to break when mid track, get back to left side

corners.braking: 50% brake pressure, break away from corner to right side
corners.exit: pick up throttle once leaving curb, follow to mid track

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: 40% brake pressure, break at debris, ease off until top of corner
corners.exit: start to accelerate at top of corner, follow to mid track

corners.label: T7
corners.exit: full throttle, lift if needed to not miss corner

corners.label: T8
corners.line: take a little bit of inside curb
corners.exit: get all the way to left side for turn nine

corners.label: T9
corners.exit: use outside curbing for exit speed
corners.mistakes: hitting curb too hard can spit you out to left side

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: 65% brake pressure, break just before gray bar
corners.mistakes: hitting curb will unil car and speed out into gravel
dropping a wheel into gravel slows the car

general_tips: Stay on the left side of the track in qualifying
Take the shortest route possible before ending up on the right side of the track for turn three
If you get a bad exit out of turn one, some people might try and overtake you into turn three
stay on left side of track while qualifying
